title: VSift ocr.search data v1
description: The data member of a complete or partial ocr.search result (0.3.0, ADR 0030 decision 13): one bounded page of the query's occurrences in the session's screen-text index, with or without a transcript. Occurrences are matched as search matches transcript segments (phrase, then all_terms) and ranked by tier, then by first appearance; a line read on consecutive read frames with the same words in the same place is one occurrence. Each hit cites its first frame, its region, its text and display_text, the runner's uncalibrated confidence, how long it stayed and the candidates of its frame (screen-text-data.schema.json#/$defs/hit). total_hits counts the whole search on every page. state is not_run before ocr has read the session, partial while its coverage of the searched range is not complete and complete otherwise; coverage is the screen-text coverage block. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json: its coverage member is truncated, and its status partial with a fixed warning, exactly when state is not complete; its reasons name not_run, or frames_pending, frames_failed, frames_awaiting_analysis and candidates_incomplete. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, query and range; it is rejected for any other search or session, after the session expires, or once ocr has committed a new index revision. Absence of a hit is never evidence the text was not on screen: only planned frames are read.

range.description: The requested range, or null when the whole index was searched.
